classification: Primary-source novelty and comparison-boundary check, not implementation or comparative performance

sources.title: SkillCommit: Evolving Agent Skills through Behaviorally Validated Scope Expansion
verified_primary_facts: Stage1 uses source ground truth and failed behavior to author a reference and procedural patch, then replays it.
Higher-level refinement hides source identities and ground truth; source replay determines supported scope.
Its OpenExempt evaluation uses the Advanced suite, independent task libraries, different users and decoding, and 210 construction /105 test tasks per family.

verified_local_facts: Pinned Curator permits ADD only; the local adapter preserves that semantics, not an intentionally disabled native DELETE.
Batch-delayed labels, one batch Curator, fixed single Qwen3-8B and existing teacher roles are declared adaptations, not a full author-default reproduction.
8192-token ACE and 4096-token main libraries, different actual TRAIN inference and teacher costs, must remain disclosed.

implications_for_this_goal: Label-assisted repair and source replay are not this project's original contribution.
Current public co-visibility commit units need actual whole-bank comparison; existing same-proposal B2 rescue is not that algorithm ablation.
Carried partial/rejected feedback needs the declared first_commit comparison; distinct actual compute prevents a pure information-only causal claim.
Current 8B/custom128 results cannot be ranked as published SkillCommit SOTA.
ACE, static, independent repetitions, two ablations and final sealed TEST remain incomplete; this audit does not replace them.
